findings.desc: packages/main/src/dashboard.ts:85 and packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts:485 index doneOutcomes with summary.outcomeKind from unchecked JSON. A parseable but invalid value (reproduced with outcomeKind="typo") creates a hidden bucket and renders "Lifecycle DONE: 1/1" with DONE-success/default=0 DONE-blocked=0 DONE-audit-only=0, so legacy/corrupt summaries silently undercount outcomes. Fix by adding a runtime normalizer/enum guard before indexing or rendering, and default unknown values to the compatibility bucket (or an explicit unknown bucket) instead of trusting the stored string.
